Supreme Court Denies Asaram Interim Bail, Allows Caretaker

The Supreme Court has denied interim bail to Asaram, who is serving a life sentence. The court considered a report from AIIMS regarding his health. While denying bail, the court permitted Asaram to engage a round-the-clock caretaker of his choice for his care. This decision comes after Asaram sought interim bail based on his deteriorating health.
